applicabilityBasis.summary: ZSD is a native dollar-targeting stablecoin marketed for stable value and transferable on the Zephyr network, so a general payment use cannot be ruled out. Its reserve-mint/redemption process converts ZEPH through autonomous protocol rules and oracle prices. The reviewed documentation does not identify a legal issuer undertaking fixed monetary-value repayment to holders; collateral can constrain redemption. GENIUS section 2(22) applicability therefore remains genuinely ambiguous under the CDP rubric, rather than being inferred solely from decentralization.

genius.notes: Reserve disclosure is a self-reported native-chain reserve snapshot, not an independent monthly cash-reserve attestation or proof that reserves satisfy GENIUS requirements. The opened 7 October snapshot reports a ZEPH reserve and ZSD/ZYS liabilities. Redemption policy refers to the public crypto-conversion algorithm, not a fiat par-redemption entitlement. No monthly independent attestation was located in the reviewed official disclosures. No legal issuer entity, domicile or regulator is assigned without evidence. Foreign-exception eligibility and enforcement posture remain unresolved; no blanket no-action assurance is asserted. GENIUS payment-issuer implementation is still in proposed-rule stages; Treasury's September 30 SCRC procedural rule does not itself activate the general issuer prohibition or accelerate section 3(b) DASP restrictions. Not-yet-restricted describes the GENIUS timing condition only and does not assure legality under other U.S. law.

sourcesChecked: Independent indexed search on 2026-10-07: (Zephyr OR ZSD) with stablecoin or GENIUS across OCC, FDIC, NCUA, Federal Reserve and NYDFS domains; no matching result found
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 7 October 2026, the independently opened OCC digital-assets licensing applications list, NYDFS regulated-entity directory and Greenlist, Federal Reserve GENIUS implementation proposals, Treasury SCRC procedural rule, and Zephyr disclosures did not establish token-specific Zephyr/ZSD GENIUS approval, officially pending application, state qualification, issuer-announced route, or registered foreign exception. An independent indexed search across OCC, FDIC, NCUA, Federal Reserve and NYDFS domains likewise found no matching Zephyr/ZSD stablecoin record. These are bounded public-evidence findings, not proof that confidential filings or permissions cannot exist. ZUSD on the NYDFS Greenlist is GMO USD, a different token. Zephyr disclosures do not identify a legal fixed-monetary-value repayment obligor.
